# Proud to be Primary

> K-3 teacher resources and curriculum platform by Elyse featuring Social-Emotional Learning, classroom management strategies, and Mindful Math materials.

Proud to be Primary is an educational resource hub dedicated to inspiring primary grade teachers with practical classroom materials, SEL curricula, and professional development. The site combines a product shop with free email training courses and a VIT (Very Important Teacher) community membership program.

## Key Topics

- Social-Emotional Learning (SEL)
- K-3 Classroom Resources
- Mindful Math Curriculum
- Classroom Management
- Morning Meetings
- Character Education
- Teacher Community
- Google Slides Resources
- Primary Grades (K-2)
- Free Email Courses
- VIT Membership
- Teaching Inspiration
- Elementary Teacher Resources
- Guided Math
- Positive Behavior

## Getting Started

- [Welcome! You've come to the right place.](https://proudtobeprimary.com/welcome-youve-come-to-the-right-place): Welcome landing page introducing Proud to be Primary and Elyse's teaching resources
- [About Me](https://proudtobeprimary.com/about-me): About Elyse and Proud to be Primary's mission for K-3 classroom inspiration
- [Become a VIT (Very Important Teacher)!](https://proudtobeprimary.com/become-a-vit-very-important-teacher): VIT membership program offering freebies and exclusive teacher community benefits

## Shop & Products

- [Shop Proud to be Primary's Education Resources for Teachers](https://shop.proudtobeprimary.com): Main shop for K-3 teacher resources including Mindful Math and classroom materials
- [Best Sellers](https://shop.proudtobeprimary.com/collections/best-sellers): Best-selling K-3 classroom resources and curriculum products from shop
- [Mind + Heart SEL Curriculum](https://shop.proudtobeprimary.com/products/social-emotional-learning-social-skills-character-education-curriculum-k-2): Mind + Heart SEL curriculum with character education and social skills lessons
- [SEL Morning Meeting Google Slides](https://shop.proudtobeprimary.com/collections/subject/products/morning-meeting-social-emotional-learning-slides-cards-distance-learning): Year-long SEL morning meeting Google Slides resource for K-3 classrooms

## Free Email Training Courses

- [SUP SEL Email Series](https://proudtobeprimary.com/sup-sel-email-series): Free SEL email course on social-emotional learning and classroom management
- [SUP Classroom Management Email Series](https://proudtobeprimary.com/sup-classroom-management-email-series): Free email course on classroom management strategies and positive behavior
- [SUP Maximize Your Mornings Email Training](https://proudtobeprimary.com/maximize-your-mornings): Free email training by Elyse on morning routines and classroom management
- [SUP Teaching Math ECourse](https://proudtobeprimary.com/teaching-math-ecourse): Free math instruction ecourse covering guided math and differentiation for K-2
